task_description: The BipedalWalker-v3 environment from Gymnasium requires a controller to keep a bipedal robot walking and moving forward. The goal is to design a heuristic control algorithm that can achieve a total reward exceeding 300 within a maximum of 1600 simulation steps. The controller receives continuous observations (24 values) and must output continuous actions (4 torques).

metrics.name: mean_score
metrics.description: Average total reward accumulated over a fixed number of evaluation episodes (each truncated at 1600 steps). Higher scores indicate better walking performance.
